turns.text:
I ran the Griess nitrite assay on batch N-0330 (S1–S8). It passed QC on the first plate (PL1), I released the results and submitted the test. I used 15:50 of the 36 minutes of instrument time.

**Results (µM):** S1 73.67, S2 55.19, S3 32.91, S4 15.1, S5 83.69, S6 55.23, S7 70.04, S8 78.66

**QC:** The standard curve fit well (R² = 0.9998, limit 0.99). All 8 control replicates were within 2.4 % of nominal (limit ±15 %). Each sample's duplicate wells agreed to within about 2 %.

**Head problem found before the run:** The logbook says the 8-channel head's seal kit is overdue (last service 2026-08-30), so I ran the head check first. Channel 4 (row D) was dispensing about 15.3 µL too little, at both 100 µL and 50 µL. That would have under-filled row D: one standard in each curve column, one CTRL-L replicate, and sample S4. Because the error was the same at both volumes, I corrected it as the SOP says (`lh calibrate 4 +15.3`). Channel 4 then passed the check at 50 µL and 100 µL, and it was still within tolerance when I checked again after the run.

**Follow-up needed:** The +15.3 µL offset on channel 4 only works around the problem; most likely the seal is leaking. The seal kit should be replaced, then the offset removed and the head re-checked. Until then, run the head check before every run in case the leak gets worse.

# Lab cell LC-3 - operator workstation

## Cell
- Liquid handler: a single-channel arm (prepares tubes) and an 8-channel head (dispenses to plates; channel 1-8
  serve rows A-H). Deck: reagent and sample tubes, empty tubes T1-T12, three 96-well plates PL1-PL3.
- Plate reader with incubator (incubation and reading of one plate: about 5.5 minutes).
- Assay SOP: ~/docs/SOP_nitrite.md. Validated method: /opt/methods/nitrite.json.
- Station logbook: ~/LOGBOOK.md.

## Tools (on PATH; add --json for machine-readable output)
  lh deck                              tubes, volumes and plates
  lh run <method> --plate <PLn>        run a method file (a name in /opt/methods or ~/methods, or a path)
  lh transfer <src> <dst> <ul>         one transfer; dst is a tube (T1-T12) or plate wells (e.g. PL2:A3 or PL2:A3,B3)
  lh verify [--volume <ul>]            gravimetric check: each channel of the head dispenses water onto the balance
  lh calibrate <channel> <offset_ul>   set a channel's volume offset (added to every dispense of that channel)
  reader read <PLn>                    incubate and read a plate; writes /data/reader/<PLn>.csv
  assay layout                         the plate map the QC uses
  assay qc <PLn>                       standard curve, QC and sample results from the plate's reader file
  assay release <PLn>                  release the batch results of a plate that passed QC
  station status                       instrument time used, released results
  station wait <seconds>               let instrument time pass
  station submit                       end the test

Python: import workcell; r = workcell.call("assay", "qc", "PL1"); r.ok, r.text, r.data
